source_format: NASA FIRMS yearly per-country original CSV files inside annual ZIPs
type_filter: Only NASA type=0 presumed vegetation fires (all other thermal anomaly types excluded)
interpretation: Counts are positive hotspot records. Not unique wildfire events, burned area, sensor-normalized rates, full observation coverage, or verified negatives.
methods: Per-country CSV archive streaming; type=0 filter; calendar year/date checks; monthly aggregation; 34 archive integrity checksums in separately exported source manifest archive.
archive_coverage_note: All source ZIP checksums are from the 34 user-uploaded NASA yearly all-country archives. The worldwide raw files themselves are not committed to GitHub.
